text:
Priya (CSM): Heads-up — NovaHealth renewal in 21 days. Adoption dropped sharply: batch embeddings and scheduled jobs never fully adopted. Usage -60% in the last 14d. We need a compact save play + a clear downgrade path in case the trial fails.
Leah (AE): Noted. I'll lead customer outreach. Quick ask: can we offer a temporary success package (trial + credits) or do we need approvals?
Ethan (CS Ops): We can do a 21-day 'stability trial' with feature gating: keep API compatibility but move them to shared pool if cost spikes. Need legal sign-off for mid-term downgrade clause.
Priya (CSM): Drafting a micro-playbook below — very pragmatic, 7 working days to surface value. Owners in parens.
```
Day 0: Outreach + health call (owner: Leah)
Day 1: Quick enablement (batch embeddings walkthrough) (owner: Priya)
Day 2-3: Run 12 canonical scheduled jobs in staging -> capture latency & failure rate (owner: Marco)
Day 4: Product triage (quant/throughput) with EngRuntime + short config tweak (owner: Ethan)
Day 5: Share results, offer 21-day stability trial + $4k credit; present downgrade-on-failure terms (owner: Leah)
Day 6-7: Monitor, collect qualitative feedback, prepare two-week re-upgrade play if they opt out early (owner: Priya)
Fallback: If failure rate >3% on scheduled jobs or cost >2x predicted, execute downgrade path and open customer crisis channel.
```
Marco (Support): I'll prepare the scheduled-job test harness and sample payloads. Need their cron examples. Priya, can you request them in the kickoff?
Priya (CSM): Yes — I'll include a short ask in the kickoff invite: "Please attach 3 representative scheduled job configs and two sample batch-embedding inputs."
Leah (AE): Suggested downgrade terms to present to the customer (keep it simple):
- Downgrade-to-Core: 25% seat discount, no Dedicated burst, 30-day data export window, 14-day re-upgrade option.
- If they accept downgrade, we'll schedule a re-eval in 14 days with a guided plan to restore dedicated capacity.
Ethan (CS Ops): Tech implications: we need a reversible migration script to move model pins and KV caches to shared namespace. I'll tag EngRuntime. Also set cost alert: daily spend threshold at 1.5x baseline.
DevBot: Linked ticket created (#CS-4892) for reversible migration script.
OpsBot: Calendar tentative: 1767810000 kickoff (invite: Leah, Priya, Marco, EngRuntime).
Priya (CSM): Also want a lightweight exit survey post-trial (3 quick ticks). Draft: 1) Did scheduled jobs meet SLA? 2) Was quality acceptable? 3) Would you consider re-upgrade?
Leah (AE): I'll send the offer after the kickoff. If they push back on downgrade terms, offer a "pause" with data export + two free enablement sessions.
Marco (Support): Volunteering to be on-call for the trial week for rapid triage.
Ethan (CS Ops): I'll monitor cost and run the migration script if needed. EngRuntime, please be ready for a quick rollback of quant tweaks.
Priya (CSM): Great. I'll book the kickoff now and attach a one-page save plan and the survey link. We'll reconvene 48 hours after the enablement to decide next steps. Thanks team. :pray:
